lines.t: Balatro was made by one anonymous developer, and it got nominated for Game of the Year.
He goes by LocalThunk, and he's from Saskatchewan, Canada.
It started in 2021 as an online version of a card game called Big Two.
Then he watched Northernlion stream Luck Be a Landlord, and turned it into a roguelike deckbuilder.
You play poker hands to score chips times mult, and collect Jokers that break the rules.
It was almost called Joker Poker. Balatro is Latin for jester.
He quit his job about a year before release, and found the composer on Fiverr.
It made over a million dollars in its first eight hours.
It sold a million copies in a month, and over five million by January 2025.
At The Game Awards, it won three awards, and was the first solo project ever nominated for Game of the Year.
One ratings board once gave it an 18 plus rating for gambling imagery. It was lowered after an appeal.
And in endless mode, around ante 39, the score you need gets so big the game just shows NaN. Not a number.
lines.say: And in endless mode, around ante thirty nine, the score you need gets so big the game just shows N, A, N. Not a number.
